summary: Kamada Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K to announce its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for August 5, 2026. The meeting includes routine proposals: re-election of seven directors, re-election of two external directors, approving option grants to director nominees, amending the share award plan to increase incentive stock option shares, and ratifying the reappointment of independent auditors. There are no deal terms, merger considerations, or strategic actions. This is a standard governance filing with no special-situation elements. The filing is non-material for event-driven analysis.
